policy: Suspicious third-party components are never promoted merely because they improve connectivity. Promotion requires provenance+hash verification, static inspection, platform malware scan where available, isolated execution appropriate to file type, and reproducible project regression. A failed severe malware gate remains quarantined; no antivirus exclusion or restore is created automatically.

rejected.reason: Microsoft Defender detected Trojan:Win32/Suschil!rfn (Severe/Concrete) on the official release archive.
Contained in the rejected archive; Windows binary was not independently source-rebuilt and clean-scanned.

notes: The archive contains cygwin1.dll and WinDivert64.sys hashes also present in the already-accepted current runtime; the archive-level detection therefore does not by itself prove those shared components malicious.
Linux nfqws2 from the official archive was only executed with --version in a systemd user sandbox with PrivateNetwork=yes and NoNewPrivileges=yes; no privileged or networked execution was performed.
Useful design ideas may be reimplemented using already-accepted runtime capabilities without shipping rejected binaries.
